name: Iori
source:
"If you make a cute girl like her cry, I will make you regret it."

One of Yuuto's childhood friends and older sister figures. One year his senior, Iori is quick-witted and never hesitates to speak her mind. Although she may complain, she's willing to become Yuuto's partner in crime if needs must, but she tends to remain cautious when it comes to matters of the heart.

Her parents are active members of the local community, and Iori has inherited their strong sense of responsibility. She deeply loves her hometown and everybody in it, often lending an ear to the other residents' worries and troubles. She and Minori were born on the same day and grew up together as bosom buddies.

[From [url=https://kanade.frontwing.co.jp/en/]official website[/url]]
